# Airo Super App — AI Agent & LLM Context Index

> Airo is a privacy-first, on-device AI super app ecosystem built with Flutter & Rust. It unifies AI Chat, Personal Finance (Airo Coins), TV & IPTV (Airo TV with EPG/M3U/XMLTV), Music, Games, and Offline Reading into one local-first application.

## Core Features & Sub-Apps

- [Airo TV Landing Page](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/tv/): High-performance leanback IPTV & Live TV player for Android TV and Fire TV with EPG grid support.
- [Airo Coins (Finance Hub)](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/coins/): On-device personal finance tracker with zero server logging and local telemetry.
- [IPTV Hub](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/iptv/): Complete player and setup specs for M3U, XMLTV, and HLS streaming.
- [Airo TV User Guides](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/tv/guides/): Comprehensive onboarding guides for Android TV, Fire TV, and Remote navigation.
- [IPTV Research Papers](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/iptv-research/): Architectural study on off-main-isolate parser execution and native Rust stream decoding.

## Technical Guides & Documentation

- [Getting Started Guide](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/getting-started/): Architecture overview and developer quickstart.
- [How to Use IPTV on Android TV](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/how-to-use-iptv-on-android-tv/): Step-by-step setup guide for Smart TVs.
- [How to Add M3U Playlist](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/how-to-add-m3u-playlist/): M3U & M3U8 file parsing, headers, and authentication setup.
- [How to Import XMLTV EPG](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/how-to-import-xmltv/): Electronic Program Guide synchronization and offline caching.
- [How to Organize Large Channel Lists](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/how-to-organize-large-channel-lists/): Category mapping, favorites, and performance tuning for 10,000+ channel streams.
- [How to Use IPTV Legally](https://developerscoffee.github.io/airo/how-to-use-iptv-legally/): Compliance and safe stream usage guidelines.

## AI Agent Integration & Architecture Rules

- **Isolate Offloading**: All parse operations, JSON decodes, M3U/EPG transforms over 50 KB execute off the main thread via `packages/core_workers` or Rust native bindings (`packages/core_native`).
- **Flavor Independence**: Flavors (`app/pubspec.yaml`, `pubspec_tv.yaml`, `pubspec_coins.yaml`) use independent entry points and isolated pubspec files.
- **Local First Data**: Drift/SQLite database operations use strict native/web conditional imports (`*_stub.dart` vs `*_native.dart`).
